chain.title: The Blue-Leafed Tree
chain.desc: Runewood generates across the Overworld. Its planks build the Spirit Altar, the Totemic Staff and the Runic Workbench.

chain.title: Stone That Remembers
chain.desc: Soulstone Ore smelted down. Every single thing in Malum traces back through this one material.

chain.title: Open the Encyclopedia
chain.desc: A book and one Soulstone. The mod's own guide, and the only place the arcana is written down.

chain.title: The First Harvest
chain.desc: Iron, sticks and Soulstone. A scythe sweeps a wide arc and, unlike any other weapon, reaps Spirits from what it kills.

chain.title: Reap the First Soul
chain.desc: Kill with a scythe and the soul rises out. Which of the eight aspects you get is decided by the creature, not by you.

chain.title: Spirit Infusion
chain.desc: Runewood planks, gold and Soulstone. Feed it an item, ring it with pedestals, and throw the demanded Spirits at it.

chain.title: Gunpowder, Cursed
chain.desc: Infuse gunpowder with a single Arcane Spirit. The cheapest infusion in the mod and an ingredient in half the rest.

chain.title: Gold Made Holy
chain.desc: A gold ingot infused with Sacred and Arcane Spirits; the metal all the mod's trinket bases are cast from.

chain.title: Somewhere to Put Them
chain.desc: Glass panes around Hallowed Gold. It holds one aspect of Spirit in bulk and feeds altars and crucibles nearby.

chain.title: Soulstained Steel
chain.desc: Iron infused with three Wicked, one Earthen and one Arcane Spirit. The mod's weapon and armour metal.

chain.title: A Better Harvest
chain.desc: The Crude Scythe rebuilt in Soulstained Steel. It reaps far more Spirit per kill, which is the whole economy of Malum.

chain.title: Stone Turned Sacred
chain.desc: Cobblestone infused with Sacred and Arcane. One half of the opposed pair every machine in the mod is built from.

chain.title: Stone Turned Wicked
chain.desc: The same infusion run with Wicked instead of Sacred. Tainted and Twisted pull against each other; that tension is the machine.

chain.title: The Crucible
chain.desc: A furnace infused with twelve Infernal and four Arcane. It focuses Spirits into an Impetus over time instead of all at once.

chain.title: A Tablet of Eight Aspects
chain.desc: The first recipe that demands Aerial, Aqueous, Earthen, Infernal AND two Eldritch at once - the mod's real difficulty spike.

chain.title: Where Runes Are Cut
chain.desc: Hallowed Gold, a Runewood pedestal and planks. Runeworking stamps a rune into a tablet using sixteen Spirits of one aspect.

chain.title: The Central Pin
chain.desc: The brooch is the focus a rune is set into, turning one-off trinkets into a socketed system you can rearrange.

chain.title: Quartz That Burns
chain.desc: Generates in the Nether and is also reaped from Nether mobs; the seed crystal for Ether.

chain.title: A Light That Does Not Go Out
chain.desc: Glowstone dust infused with Infernal and Arcane. It burns in colours, lights the Catalyzer and never needs fuel.

chain.title: Heat the Crucible
chain.desc: A Twisted Rock pedestal infused with Infernal and Aerial. Up to eight fuelled Catalyzers accelerate one Crucible.

chain.title: Clay, Rendered
chain.desc: Clay infused with Arcane, Earthen and Aqueous. The blank substrate under every augment and every Impetus.

chain.title: The Crucible's Heart
chain.desc: Calx, Hex Ash and Soulstone. Placed in the Crucible it is the thing Spirits are actually focused into.

chain.title: Gold From Below
chain.desc: Cthonic Gold Ore generates in the deeps. It is what turns a plain Impetus into a metal-specific one.

chain.title: Spirit Focusing
chain.desc: An Alchemical Impetus and Cthonic Gold, taking eight Earthen and eight Infernal. Focused in the Crucible it duplicates copper.

chain.title: The Aspect That Gates Everything
chain.desc: Reaped only from Endermen, Endermites, Shulkers, Evokers, Ravagers, Elder Guardians and the Wither. Nothing late runs without it.

chain.title: The Weeping Well
chain.desc: A generated structure with a pool of Primordial Soup at its heart. Throw items in and the void hands something else back.

chain.title: Favor of the Void
chain.desc: Hex Ash surrendered to the Weeping Well. The favor_of_the_void recipe type is a second, separate crafting economy.

chain.title: Slate Without Properties
chain.desc: Soulstone given to the well. It is the base of Malignant Pewter and of the Void Tablet.

chain.title: Lead of the Black Crystal
chain.desc: Cthonic Gold given to the well, and the first item on the hidden black-crystal branch of the mod.

chain.title: Pewter, Malignant
chain.desc: Iron infused with sixteen Earthen and four Eldritch alongside Malignant Lead and Null Slate. The endgame alloy.

chain.title: Runes of the Void
chain.desc: A Tainted Rock Tablet with Null Slate and Void Salts, taking four Eldritch. It carries the runes nothing else can hold.

chain.title: The Book, Rewritten
chain.desc: Throw the Encyclopedia Arcana into the Weeping Well. What comes back documents the chapters the first book would not.

chain.title: The Last Scythe
chain.desc: A Soulstained Steel Scythe and Malignant Pewter, taking thirty-two Earthen, thirty-two Wicked and sixteen Eldritch.

notes: VERIFICATION: 494 stems pass item-model INTERSECT (lang key OR recipe result OR loot entry OR tag OR advancement); 487 survive the obtainability audit. The recipe scanner unwraps forge:conditional wrappers, without which 20 impetus and node ids look sourceless. All 33 chain ids, 6 wheel hubs and 54 wheel members (93 ids total) were re-checked, fully namespaced, against the surviving set on a second pass whose derivation is deliberately independent of the first: exact item-model path existence plus the literal "<ns>:<path>" string appearing in the jar data trees. 0 failures. DROPS, all registered-but-unreachable: malum:umbral_spirit is the headline one - it has a model, an item.malum.umbral_spirit key reading 'Umbral Spirit', and sits in data/malum/tags/items/spirit.json, but that tag is literally ['#malum:aspected_spirits', 'malum:umbral_spirit'], i.e. it is deliberately NOT an aspected spirit; it appears in zero of the 732 data/malum/spirit_data/entity/*.json files, in zero of the 98 spirit_infusion recipes, in no loot table and in no reaping_data, and the guide book only teases it ('Strange equations - assuming an absence of existence'). It cannot be obtained in 1.6.7. Also dropped: ritual_shard (5 brightness model variants and a lang key, but no recipe, loot, tag or structure - the 'Ritual magic' book headline is unimplemented), ritual_plinth (a real block with a RitualPlinthBlock class and a self-drop loot table, but no recipe and it does not appear in data/malum/structures/weeping_well.nbt, so nothing places it), void_depot (same shape - class, model, self-drop loot, no recipe, not in the structure), creative_scythe (in the scythe and magic_capable_weapon tags only, no recipe), soul_of_a_scythe (two model files and nothing else anywhere in the jar), and token_of_gratitude (a CurioTokenOfGratitude cosmetic in data/curios/tags/items/charm.json with no in-game source). TIER GATE: the analogue of Bewitchment's chalk tier is SPIRIT ASPECT. Every malum:spirit_infusion recipe declares a 'spirits' array of {type,count}, and across the 98 of them the aspects appear arcane 47, earthen 39, wicked 38, ELDRITCH 35, aqueous 30, infernal 23, aerial 21, sacred 19. Eldritch is the real gate: data/malum/spirit_data shows it is reaped only from enderman, endermite, shulker, evoker, ravager, elder_guardian and wither, and it is required by tainted_rock_tablet (2), void_tablet (4), malignant_pewter_ingot (4), mnemonic_hex_staff (8), tyrving (8), catalyst_lobber (8), edge_of_deliverance (16), weight_of_worlds (16) and erosion_scepter (16). Underneath that sits a second gate, the Weeping Well: malum:favor_of_the_void is a whole separate recipe type (13 recipes) performed by throwing items into malum:primordial_soup, which exists only inside the generated structure data/malum/worldgen/structure/weeping_well.json. Everything on the hidden black-crystal branch (data/malum/tags/items/hidden_items/black_crystal.json - malignant pewter, the stronghold armour, weight_of_worlds, edge_of_deliverance, erosion_scepter, mnemonic_hex_staff, void_tablet) is behind that well. ENTITIES: no kill step is offered. All 12 entity.malum.* keys are projectiles or vehicles - auric_flame_bolt, draining_bolt, etheric_nitrate, hex_bolt, hidden_blade_delayed_impact, scythe_boomerang, thrown_gluttony, vivid_nitrate, two boats, plus natural_spirit and pneuma_void which are the visual soul entities the scythe releases, not mobs. Malum registers no killable creature; every spirit source is a vanilla or other-mod mob. NON-RECIPE ACQUISITION kept and verified: the 8 aspected spirits (spirit_data), warp_flux (data/malum/reaping_data/enderman.json, 10% for 2-4), grim_talc, rotting_essence, blazing_quartz and astral_weave (also reaping_data), runic_sap and cursed_sap (SapFilledLogBlock - collected from exposed/revealed Runewood and Soulwood logs), and the 12 cracked_*_impetus items, which the Crucible produces when an Impetus fails and which feed data/malum/recipes/spirit_crucible/repair/metal_impetus_restoration.json. PACK-DEPENDENT: the aluminum, cobalt, lead, nickel, osmium, silver, tin, uranium and zinc impetus and node pairs (18 ids) come only from forge:conditional recipes gated on those metals existing, so they are counted but deliberately kept out of the wheels; copper, gold and iron are the three unconditional ones. CONSENSUS: moddb.json and harvested_order.json both have no malum entry, so there is no consensus ordering to cross-check and no conflict to record - the chain is built purely from the recipe graph and the spirit-aspect gate.
